poses.caption: Stand with feet shoulder-width apart and hold the bar at shoulder height with an overhand grip slightly narrower than your shoulders.
Brace your trunk and press overhead without leg drive or arching your back. Extend both arms, then lower the bar under control.

jobs.prompt: Use case scientific-educational. Original premium ADULT male detailed anatomical exercise illustration canonical1456 BARBELL STANDING CLOSE GRIP MILITARY PRESS. TWO equal square cells side by side wide2:1 landscape same full body person camera scale. Front-side three-quarter view shows both grips. Feet shoulder width soles flat fixed floor, knees straight soft NEVER leg drive, pelvis/ribs stacked neutral spine no backward arch. One straight chrome barbell equal modest round plates secure collars. BOTH hands OVERHAND PRONATED grip just SLIGHTLY NARROWER than shoulder width, thumbs wrapped, same grip spacing in both poses. LEFT START bar across upper FRONT chest at clavicle height not behind neck, elbows below/slightly forward bar close to torso, wrists reasonably stacked over elbows. RIGHT FINISH press bar STRAIGHT OVERHEAD slightly behind forehead aligned shoulders and MIDFOOT, BOTH elbows extended soft, arms close ears, bar fully clears head with generous gap, ribs stay down torso tall. Same bar length load proportions unchanged, no extra weights. Primary exposed BOTH DELTOID shoulder caps RED ONLY, triceps chest forearms grayscale. Fine detailed grayscale exposed anatomical muscle contours realistic hands fingers proportions. Full opaque BLACK tank wraps FRONT SIDES BACK, black MID-THIGH shorts cover FRONT SIDES BACK SEAT CROTCH seams broad cloth folds intact no transparency/cutaway/fibers through fabric. Black shoes. Pure WHITE background soft contact shadows generous12percent margins full head raised bar ends/plates fingers both feet inside EACH cell uncropped. Equal male/female quality. Original project reference rendering STYLE ONLY ignore pushup/chest red. No text labels captions arrows extra figures.
